candidates.readme_excerpt:
Make the scene first. Then make it a video.
Open source previs in a browser tab: block the set, move the cast, cut the camera, hand the shot to an AI video model.

Try it in the browser · Quick start · Guide for AI agents · Docs · Changelog

Top: the greybox blocked in CozyClay. Bottom: the AI video made from it. Same idea, a parkour jump: the blocking holds the timing and the camera.
## Why AI video costs money per take, and one miss means paying again. A text prompt cannot hold a whole scene: where everyone stands, how they move, where the camera is, when it cuts. CozyClay lets you make those decisions first, in 3D, where they are cheap to change. Then the video model gets the shot as a first frame, a greybox reference clip and a prompt that describes the real framing. It follows the blocking instead of guessing. ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Stage
set + cast"] --> M["Motion
compiled + QA"] --> C["Camera
shots + cuts"] --> E["Export
frame · clip · prompt"] --> V["AI video model"] ``` ## Quick start ```bash npx cozyclay ``` That is the whole install. You need Node.js 22.19 or newer and a Chromium browser. You do not need a GPU, Python or a model download. The studio opens at `http://127.0.0.1:5180/app

Designed for agentic coding workflows and compatible with Agent Skills–style environments.

## What it does?

The skill guides an AI coding agent through the complete landing-page workflow:

1. Analyze the existing page
2. Fix technical SEO issues
3. Optimize HTML structure
4. Improve Core Web Vitals
5. Optimize images and fonts
6. Add structured data
7. Remove unnecessary dependencies
8. Validate the final implementation

## Why?

AI can generate a beautiful landing page in seconds.
The problem is that generated pages often contain:

- unnecessary JavaScript
- oversized images
- poor semantic structure
- missing structured data
- weak metadata
- performance bottlenecks
- technical SEO mistakes

SEO Landing Skill gives the agent a repeatable technical SEO workflow instead of relying on generic prompting.

An agent skill that builds and updates landing pages toward **100/100 lab PageSpeed** and Core Web Vitals-friendly performance, and gets the technical SEO right. Static HTML, critical CSS, AVIF images, full schema.org markup, zero third-party requests on first load (deferred widgets, when used, are consent-gated and documented in the dependency manifest). # Open Duet: Open-Source AI Coworkers You Run Yourself **Open Duet is an open-source, self-hosted workspace for AI coworkers: named agents that each have a job, instructions, memory, their own workspace and isolated computer, a schedule, and a human approval step before they do anything risky.** You chat with them in a browser, a desktop app or Telegram, hand them recurring routines, and keep their data and credentials on your own machine or server. It is an open alternative to Claude Duet and to other paid AI agent products such as OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse, Grok Bot, Instinct, Manus Cue, Claude Cowork, and ChatGPT agent, and is not yet a feature-for-feature replacement for them. An agent can be anything you would hand work to: a researcher, a support triager, a reporting assistant, a developer. Coding is one thing agents do, not what Open Duet is. Agents run on an engine you already have signed in (Claude, Codex, any Agent Client Protocol CLI, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Teams of agents that delegate to each other, rooms, and connectors to other apps are planned, not built; see [docs/ROADMAP.md](docs/ROADMAP.md).

# VisionClaw

![VisionClaw](assets/teaserimage.png)

A real-time AI assistant for Meta Ray-Ban smart glasses. See what you see, hear what you say, and take actions on your behalf -- all through voice.

![Cover](assets/cover.png)

Built on [Meta Wearables DAT SDK](https://github.com/facebook/meta-wearables-dat-ios) (iOS) / [DAT Android SDK](https://github.com/nichochar/openclaw) (Android) + [Gemini Live API](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/live) + [OpenClaw](https://github.com/nichochar/openclaw) (optional).

**Supported platforms:** iOS (iPhone) and Android (Pixel, Samsung, etc.)

## What It Does

Put on your glasses, tap the AI button, and talk:

- **"What am I looking at?"** -- Gemini sees through your glasses camera and describes the scene
- **"Add milk to my shopping list"** -- delegates to OpenClaw, which adds it via your connected apps
- **"Send a message to John saying I'll be late"** -- routes through OpenClaw to WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage
- **"Search for the best coffee shops nearby"** -- web search via OpenClaw, results spoken back

The glasses camera streams at ~1fps to Gemini for visual context, while audio flows bidirectionally in real-time.

## How It Works

![How It Works](assets/how.png)

```
Meta Ray-Ban Glasses (or phone camera)
       |
       | video frames + mic audio
       v
iOS / Android App (this project)
       |
       | JPEG frames (~1fps) + PCM audio (16kHz)
       v
Gemini Live API (WebSocket)
       |
       |-- Audio response (PCM 24kHz) --> App --> Speaker
       |-- Tool calls (execute) -------> App --> OpenClaw Gateway
       |                                              |
       |                                              v
       |                                      56+ skills: web search,
       |                                      messaging, smart home,
       |                                      notes, reminders, etc.
       |                                              |
       |<---- Tool response (text) <----- App <-------+
       |
       v
  Gemini speaks the result
```

**Key pieces:**
- **Gemini Live** -- real-time voice + vision AI over WebSocket (native audio, not STT-first)
- **OpenClaw** (optional) -- local gateway that gives Gemini access to 56+ tools and all your connected apps
- **Phone mode** -- test the full pipeline using your phone camera instead of glasses
- **WebRTC streaming** -- share your glasses POV live to a browser viewer

candidates.description: 把文章、案例或笔记排成 3:4 小红书图文 | 1080×1440 | 20 个母版 | 浅色 / 深色 | Claude Code Skill
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Ian XHS Carousel

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

> 把文章、案例或笔记，排成一组 3:4 的小红书图文。
>
> 1080×1440 竖版 | 20 个母版 | 浅色 / 深色 | Claude Code Skill

---

## 这是什么

Ian XHS Carousel 是一个 AI Skill，把你的内容做成一组小红书轮播图，风格是简洁的产品界面风。

你把内容交给它，它先出一张分镜表给你确认，确认后再排版、出图。

**最好用 Claude 跑。**

---

## 适合谁用

- 写文章、做案例拆解，想顺手发一份小红书图文的人
- 做 AI、产品、设计、效率工具内容，图里常有截图、步骤、对比、数据、代码的人
- 想让每期图文风格统一、看着干净的人

想要手绘、插画、大色块海报这类风格的话，这个不太合适。

---

## 它会产出什么

- **分镜表**：每页讲什么、用哪个母版、标题怎么写，先给你确认
- **每页一张 PNG**：1080×1440，可以直接发
- **总览图**：所有页排在一起，一眼看整组节奏
- **HTML 源文件**：想自己改字、换图，改完重新渲染就行

浅色、深色两版都能出，版式一样。

小红书帖子的标题、正文和话题标签需要你另外写。

---

## 20 个母版

![20 个母版 · 浅色](examples/images/templates-light.png)

<details>
<summary>深色版</summary>

![20 个母版 · 深色](examples/images/templates-dark.png)

</details>

| 分组 | 母版 |
|---|---|
| 封面 | T01 对话框、T02 窗口、T03 通知 |
| 讲做法 | T04 步骤、T05 清单、T06 时间线 |
| 对比 | T07 对错、T08 前后双栏 |
| 展示 | T09 宫格、T10 截图标注、T11 手机截图、T12 应用列表 |
| 数字 | T13 数据指标、T14 参数设置 |
| 文字 | T15 观点大字、T16 聊天、T17 提示词、T18 代码 |
| 结尾 | T19 对照、T20 完成 |

20 个都不合适的时候，AI 会用同一套样式拼一个新排法。

---

## 安装

**1. 下载并复制到 Claude Code**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xhs-carousel.git
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
cp -R ./ian-xhs-carousel/ian-xhs-carousel ~/.claude/skills/
```

**2. 装渲染要用的工具**（第一次用时装一次）

```bash
pip install playwright pillow
playwright install chromium
```

渲染时会联网加载英文和代码字体，记得保持网络畅通。

---

## 素材要好看

一组图好不好看，很大程度看你给的素材。上传前花几分钟挑一挑：

- **截图**：用高清的，裁掉浏览器工具栏、桌面和别的窗口；做深色版就截深色模式的
- **Logo 和图标**：用官方的 SVG，别截一个小图再放大
- **照片和效果图**：一堆里挑最好看的那张
- **没有好图**：先空着，它会在分镜表里列出来问你要，别拿糊的凑

---

## 怎么用

在 Claude Code 里输入：

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 把下面这篇文章做成一组小红书图文。

<粘贴文章>
```

不输命令也行，直接说"把这篇做成小红书"，它一般会自己用上。

**只要分镜表**

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 先别排版，帮我看看下面这篇能做成几页，出分镜表就行。

<粘贴文章>
```

**出深色版**

```text
/ian-xhs-carousel 把这篇做成小红书图文，用深色主题。截图在 ./shots 里。

<粘贴文章>
```

**改某一页**

```text
第 3 页换成 T08 前后双栏，左边放旧版截图，右边放新版。
```

更多示例见 [examples/prompts.md](examples/prompts.md)。

---

## 工作流程

1. **读内容**：想清楚这组图要让人带走什么
2. **出分镜表**：一页讲一件事，一般 5 页左右，**停下来等你确认**
3. **准备配图**：用你给的素材，缺的会列出来问你
4. **排版**：从 20 个母版里挑合适的
5. **渲染和自查**：检查文字溢出、字号、配色，有问题自己改掉
6. **交付**：给你每页图和总览图

---

## 小贴士

- 分镜表那一步多花点时间，页数和每页讲什么定下来，后面基本不用返工
- 图上的字越少越好，说不完的留给正文
- 页数宁少勿多，5 页左右刚好

---

## 目录结构

```text
.
├── README.md
├── README.en.md
├── examples/              母版总览图、更多提示词
└── ian-xhs-carousel/      ← 安装的是这个文件夹
    ├── SKILL.md
    ├── assets/            样式、母版、图标
    ├── references/        设计规则、母版说明、自查清单
    └── scripts/           渲染脚本
```

---

candidates.readme_excerpt:
# douyin-to-obsidian

把抖音视频、图文和收藏夹中的知识整理到自己的 Obsidian。面向 **cc-connect + Claude Code** 的 /dy 技能：Python 负责材料获取、本地识别、查重和事务写入，当前会话的模型负责理解、纠错和知识提炼。

Douyin videos, image posts and collections → structured Obsidian notes. Full support: Apple Silicon macOS, Chrome, Python 3.12 and a configured cc-connect Claude Code workspace.

## 能做什么

- 导入单个作品、分享口令或多个链接；收藏夹只补充尚未入库的作品。
- 视频使用本地 MLX Whisper 转写；图文逐页 Apple Vision OCR，再由支持读图的模型核对原图。
- 按主题生成知识笔记、自测和有依据的模型补充，附上原作品链接。
- 用作品 ID 查重；已有笔记改名、移动后仍能识别，不覆盖其正文或个人修改。
- 笔记、图文附件、知识总索引、导入总日志通过同一事务提交，失败时回滚。
- 保留批次状态、有限浏览器恢复、清单缺口和逐条失败链接；不无限重试。
- 粘贴包含“复制打开抖音”的分享口令可以自动路由；普通讨论或明确拒绝导入时不启动导入。

这不是独立的自动摘要服务。只运行 Python 不会代替模型生成知识正文；宿主需要 Read、Write、命令执行和读图能力。公开视频也可能受平台接口、网络或权限限制，不能保证任意链接均可访问。

## 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Apple Silicon Mac；Intel Mac、Windows、Linux 未验证，不提供完整支持 |
| Python | 3.12；安装命令使用你自己的解释器绝对路径 |
| Node.js | 本机可执行的 Node.js，供 F2 的 JavaScript 签名使用 |
| Chrome | 已安装，使用你自己的用户资料；私人收藏夹需要该资料已登录抖音 |
| OCR | Xcode Command Line Tools，包含 xcrun 和 Swift |
| 宿主 | 已配置好模型和渠道的 cc-connect，后端为 Claude Code |
| Obsidian | 已存在、可读写的 Vault；无须额外 Obsidian 插件 |

安装器只配置所选工作区的 /dy 技能、命令与路由 Hook，不配置模型账号或聊天渠道。先参照 [cc-connect 官方说明](https://github.com/chenhg5/cc-connect) 完成宿主配置。

如果尚未安装 Command Line Tools，可在终端运行：

~~~sh
xcode-select --install
~~~

## 1. 下载

在 GitHub 页面选择 Code → Download ZIP，解压后进入目录；也可以：

~~~sh
git clone https://github.com/llm-xiaoye/douyin-to-obsidian.git
cd douyin-to-obsidian
~~~

建议使用 [Releases](https://github.com/llm-xiaoye/douyin-to-obsidian/releases) 中的版本。ZIP 与 Git clone 使用相同安装步骤。

## 2. 确定自己的路径

你需要提供：

1. **cc-connect 工作区**：该项目中 Claude Code 实际使用的 work_dir，不是 cc-connect 程序目录。
2. **Obsidian Vault**：你的知识库根目录，里面可以已有其他笔记。
3. **Chrome Profile**：在用于登录抖音的 Chrome 中打开 chrome://version，复制“个人资料路径 / Profile Path”。例如 Default 或 Profile 1 所在的完整目录，不能只填用户数据父目录。

默认 Chrome 数据目录可自动推导对应缓存。自定义 --user-data-dir 必须另传 --browser-cache-dir，指向同一资料的 Cache_Data。安装器不会创建 Chrome Profile、复制 Cookie 或要求你导出登录凭据。

## 3. 安装

在下载目录执行，先把下面四个值换成你自己的绝对路径。保留双引号以支持中文和空格：

~~~sh
DY_PYTHON="/absolute/path/to/python3.12"
DY_WORKSPACE="/absolute/path/to/cc-connect-workspace"
DY_VAULT="/absolute/path/to/YourVault"
DY_PROFILE="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome/Default"

"$DY_PYTHON" -B scripts/install.py \
  --workspace "$DY_WORKSPACE" \
  --vault "$DY_VAULT" \
  --browser-profile "$DY_PROFILE"
~~~

其他可选参数：

~~~text
--browser-cache-dir "/absolute/path/to/Chrome/Cache_Data"
--cache-dir "/absolute/path/to/dy-runtime-cache"
~~~

默认运行缓存为当前用户的 ~/Library/Caches/douy
